name: End-of-lease cleaning (category guide)
summary: Professional / curtain / deep-clean clauses at handover — what TAs actually require, invoice discipline for deposit release, and when make-good quotes are landlord theatre.
body: Many Singapore TAs quietly require professional cleaning, curtain dry-cleaning, or ‘return in same condition’ language that landlords read as a full-flat deep clean at exit. Negotiate scope at LOI: ask for the prior tenant’s cleaning receipts if the clause is mandatory, and photograph move-in condition so fair wear is not rebranded as damage. Hire cleaners with itemised invoices (rooms, curtains, kitchen degrease, bathroom descaling) dated before handover — WhatsApp cash jobs lose deposit fights. Curtain and sofa dry-clean quotes should match the inventory annex, not a surprise whole-home package. Pair cleaning with aircon reinstatement clauses and pest clearance only when the TA or infestation evidence requires it — bundling everything into one vendor often inflates the bill. SCT and counsel paths exist for abusive make-good invoices after multi-year stays; inventory photos beat rhetoric. This is a category guide for honest handover cleaning, not a ranked maid-agency list. Family ops note: helper rest-day Sundays are a bad day to schedule end-of-lease cleans — dual-career coverage collapses when cleaners and kids both need the living room.
